status: one-seed text-prefix convergence diagnostic; not a headline result
interpretation: The eight-epoch direct text-prefix control was severely under-optimized and cannot support a latent-over-text comparison.
With the same data and architecture trained for 40 joint epochs, the direct causal baseline nearly solves the held-out task.

The apparent advantage of the eight-epoch latent pilots over the eight-epoch text run is therefore an optimization-speed result, not evidence that latent conditioning is superior to direct symbolic access.
The strongest Z-only condition must receive a comparable convergence run before the causal gates are judged.
